local_reimplementations.name: MemberManagement
local_reimplementations.notes: member + invite admin list, plain div v-for (not <table>, not <ul>); server endpoint returns ALL members/invites with no limit/pagination at all

local_reimplementations.name: CameraManagement
local_reimplementations.notes: camera admin list, <section v-for>, unbounded server query

local_reimplementations.name: ShareManagement
local_reimplementations.notes: share-link admin list, div v-for, unbounded server query

local_reimplementations.name: CameraPlayer
local_reimplementations.notes: live camera stream player, client-only, most-reused component in the app

filter_search_bar.notes: date picker + camera-id select filtering /api/recordings/day; no free-text search

card_list.notes: one <section> card per camera with inline edit controls

detail_list.notes: member/invite rows as plain divs, no table semantics

share_social.notes: generates/manages share links (token-based), not narduk-core AppShareButtons (social share) -- different domain, name collision only

auth_gating_ui.notes: requireNvrOrg(event, 'admin') gate; role remapped 'crew' -> 'viewer' in the response

top_extraction_candidates.name: MemberManagement/CameraManagement/ShareManagement
top_extraction_candidates.why: three near-identical hand-rolled admin list panels (members, cameras, shares), all plain div v-for with no table semantics, no pagination, and (for members) no server-side limit at all -- smallest, cleanest candidate set for a shared admin-list/table component

top_extraction_candidates.name: RecordingPlayer
top_extraction_candidates.why: date-scoped recording filmstrip is a distinct reusable shape from the almanac/passage timelines seen elsewhere in L7

top_extraction_candidates.name: history.vue date+camera filter
top_extraction_candidates.why: simple two-field filter bar pattern repeated in spirit across every list/history view in L7 repos

notes: Smallest app surveyed in L7 (14 .vue files) -- a household security-camera NVR frontend, mostly live-video/PTZ UI rather than data-heavy screens. Zero narduk-libs UI component tag usage found despite narduk-core/narduk-auth being dependencies (same auto-registered-via-layer pattern as mybo-at-v2). Notable risk: server/api/members/index.get.ts returns every member and invite with no limit/pagination at all, unlike mybo-at-v2's deliberate ORG_LIST_LIMIT -- low risk at this app's expected scale (household orgs) but exactly the unbounded-list shape mybo-at-v2 issue #14 flagged as a defect in a similar context.
